# DANZUS Holdings LLC

DANZUS Holdings LLC is in Folsom, California. Dan Johnson builds websites and
sets up local search and AI assistants for small businesses in Sacramento,
Folsom, Roseville, El Dorado Hills, and nearby. A website starts at $1,500.
SEO and AI search starts at $300 a month. A Google Business Profile and AI
listing starter starts at $150 a month. Assistant packages are a flat monthly
price. This is not a chatbot you have to run yourself.

Contact: call or text (916) 404-6129, or email dan@danzus.co.
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/danjohnsondata
Website: https://danzus.co

## What the assistant does

- Missed-call text-back within 60 seconds.
- Replies to website and Facebook leads.
- Quote follow-up.
- Booking and reminders.
- Google review requests after a finished job.
- Inbox triage, invoice nudges, and a weekly summary.
- Answers to hours, service area, and which jobs the shop takes.

About 80% of a package is a ready-made template. About 20% is written for the
shop. It connects to the calendar, QuickBooks, a CRM, or the texts the shop
already uses. The owner reads the replies. A person signs off on anything risky
before it reaches a customer. Each month DANZUS reads what went out and fixes
what sounds off.

## Website

A custom site for one local business. It is fast on a phone and built so the
next step is a call or a lead: the services, the towns covered, tap to call,
and a way to send a lead. Starting at $1,500. A project, not a monthly assistant.

## SEO and AI search

Google Business Profile, local SEO for the towns the shop serves, schema and
structured data, an llms.txt file, and pages a person or an AI can read, so the
business can show up in Google and in answers from tools such as ChatGPT and
Perplexity. Starting at $300 a month.

A Google Business Profile and AI listing starter starts at $150 a month, for a
shop that is not ready for the fuller search package.

## Packages

### Lead to Booked Job

A new inquiry becomes a time on the calendar: capture the lead, instant reply,
qualify, book, and remind. One step can start on Pilot or Starter. The full
package fits Growth.

### Quote to Cash

An estimate becomes money in the account: draft the estimate, follow up, send
the invoice, and chase the payment. Follow-up alone is Starter. QuickBooks is
Custom.

### Job Closeout

A finished job leaves a review and a referral: completion photos, a review
request, and a referral ask. Fits Growth.

### Back Office

The inbox, the bills, and the week land in one place: inbox triage, receipts
and bills into the books, and a weekly summary for the owner. Fits Custom.
Inbox triage alone can start on Starter.

### Customer Service

The customer gets an answer, a status, or a person: FAQ answers, job or order
status, and a handoff. FAQ answers fit Starter. Live job or order status is
Custom.

## Starting prices

Every number is a starting range. Setup is separate. The free call turns the
range into a fixed quote before setup begins.

- Pilot: $150 a month. Setup starting at $250. First three Sacramento-area shops. One package, in exchange for an honest testimonial.
- Starter: $200 to $300 a month. Setup starting at $500. One package.
- Growth: $400 to $600 a month. Setup starting at $1,000 to $1,500. Lead to Booked Job, Quote to Cash, and Job Closeout together.
- Custom: $100 to $150 an hour. Setup starting at $1,500. Back Office, live status, and writing into software the shop already runs.
- Website: starting at $1,500.
- SEO and AI search: starting at $300 a month.
- Google Business Profile and AI listing: starting at $150 a month.

## Questions

- What does it cost? See the starting ranges above. The free call fixes the quote.
- How long does setup take? The free call picks the first job. Most of the package is a template, then it is connected to tools the shop already uses.
- Do I need new software? No.
- Is it secure? A person signs off on anything risky before it goes out. Mobile phone numbers and SMS opt-in data and consent are not shared with any third parties or affiliates. https://danzus.co/privacy
- What if the AI says something wrong? Risky messages wait for a person. Each month DANZUS reads what was sent and fixes what sounds off. An upset customer gets the owner.
- Do you work in person? Dan is in Folsom. The free call is by phone. The service area is Sacramento, Folsom, Roseville, El Dorado Hills, and nearby.

Reply STOP to opt out at any time. Reply HELP for help, or contact
dan@danzus.co or (916) 404-6129. Consent is not a condition of purchase.
Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. Privacy:
